{{Quote|Better have my protocol droid standing by.''"<br />"''Your Brilliancy will recall that he was, ah, ''reassigned'' when his translation of your joke about the ''three Hardex'' and the ''bantha'' failed to amuse the Hardexian ambassador.|Craw and Steggus|<ref name="Droids 6" />}}
For some [[Time/Legends|time]], a '''protocol droid''' served [[Craw]], the self-titled [[Dictator-Forever]] of<ref name="Droids 6" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|219|Targonn}}</ref> [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]]. At some point, Craw told a visiting [[Unidentified Hardexian ambassador|Hardexian ambassador]] a joke about three [[Hardex]] and a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]. When the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] was not amused by the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid's]] [[Translator/Legends|translation]] of the joke, Craw had the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] deactivated and turned into a fountain. In his new function, the droid's frame stood posed on one [[Limb/Legends|leg]] with both arms outstretched while [[Water/Legends|water]] flowed from his [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and [[Bird/Legends|birds]] used the structure as a perch.<ref name="Droids 6" />

In [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]],<ref name="Omnibus" /> Craw requested that his protocol droid be standing by. However, the [[Targonnian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Steggus]] reminded him that he had been repurposed. The Dictator-Forever became frustrated, demanding Steggus acquire another one to replace him. The bipedal protocol droid had [[Color/Legends|light orange]] plating<ref name="Droids 6" /> and was classified as a [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]].<ref name="SECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for all [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The protocol droid appeared in the [[Droids (1995) 6|sixth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series [[Star Wars: Droids (1994)|''Star Wars: Droids'']], which was written by [[Jan Strnad]], illustrated by [[Bill Hughes]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Droids 6" /> on [[October 31]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54170/star_wars_droids_1995_6|text=Star Wars: Droids (1995) #6}}</ref>
